name: Winstek Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Winstek Semiconductor Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the testing of integrated circuits, chip bumping, and wafer packaging services in Taiwan, United State, Mainland China, Singapore, and internationally. It operates through Test Business and Packaging Business segment. The company offers test services, such as wafer sort, final test, post-test, engineering support, and test platforms services; and bump services, including copper pillar bump, wafer level chip scale package, lead free bump, plating bump/ball drop/RDL, 6S protection, heterogeneous bump, and backside metallization services.
